children: Australia's housing market is suffering convulsions as prices dive at their fast pace on record while new lending for homes has entered a virtual free fall. The highest interest rates in 18 years and added taxes on property investors are greasing the retreat. Housing auctions are also in a slump. The so-called auction clearance rate dropped to 44.0% last week, down from 51.5% a week earlier, says property research firm Cotality. The RBA may yet leave the door open for further interest rate increases, so the worst may not yet be over. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
